lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters. Posterior to the gills, a grouping of four blobs forms a vertically-oriented rectangular pattern, followed by a subsequent column of three blobs positioned at approximately equal intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, with the circular high-luminance blobs positioned at the intersection points where these vertical bands cross horizontal axes, creating a grid-like structural arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadowed trough immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots is visible within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin, concentrated primarily along the leading edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior-distal margin of the foreground pectoral fin, exhibiting a localized loss of structural integrity.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple slender, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) are visible clustered near the ventral surface and the posterior margin of the foreground pectoral fin.
